claim: On Oracle Cloud 4x A10 24GB with one GPU per node over standard Ethernet, DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 reaches 18,147 tok/s at 4 GPUs, +48% vs DDP, while ZeRO-2 at 2 GPUs is -24% vs DDP and ZeRO-3 at 4 GPUs is -31% vs DDP.
stance_target: The assumption that ZeRO-2 always pays a communication penalty relative to DDP
scope_conditions: 4x NVIDIA A10 24GB, 1 GPU per node, standard Ethernet (eth0) for A10; RDMA/InfiniBand only on A100/H100; TinyGPT model
quoted_support: DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 dominates with 18,147 tokens/sec at 4 GPUs, 48% faster than DDP, 93% faster than FSDP at 4 GPUs
numbers: -31% vs DDP for ZeRO-3 at 4 GPUs

claim: Because each A10 sits on a separate node and the interconnect is Ethernet rather than an intra-node PCIe bus, this benchmark measures a network fabric and is silent on host-staged PCIe behaviour.
